en_a1.text: EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS · LLM AGENT RELIABILITY
Tool errors ≠ task failure | Reading risk, recovery and stopping costs from traces
Three proposal research questions · 6,000 real-model runs · training-only EDA · frozen test
01 | DESIGN: at step t, predict final failure using only observed events

20 templates × 20 instances × 5 conditions × 3 repeats = 6,000
Ticket + incident; normal/timeout/rate-limit/schema/partial response
Train/validation/test = 3,542/1,176/1,176; parent families 6/2/2
No template or prefix crosses splits; 106 invalid runs audited separately

Score after a tool return; use current and past events only.
Fault settings, future steps and verifier answers are never inputs.

Errors/retries/repeats, tokens/cost/time, tool and write context
LR + KNN + fixed rules; validation false-stop budget
Report recall, timing, savings and success loss together
No online intervention; every stopping gain is offline replay
02 | EDA: five figures answer the proposal's core questions
TRAIN ONLY: 3,542 valid tasks / 27,367 prefixes; no validation/test EDA. Supplementary figures are post-hoc exploration and did not alter the frozen main experiment; associations are descriptive.
Partial response: 45.9% incident vs 8.7% ticket failure. Normal conditions still have 170 failures; template failure spans 0.67%–90.41%. Facet and split by parent family.
Errors recover; success can be late
51.21% of successes show explicit errors; 4,031/5,926 read errors recover (68.02%). 77 successes first complete at step 12: an error alone is not a stopping rule.
Full-run gaps are not early signals
Full-run token medians separate, but step-3 means do not: incident success/failure 4,277/4,226; ticket 4,246/4,289. Final consumption cannot stand in for early information.
Within incident zero-error cells, repetition coincides with lower failure (15.8% vs 42.8%); one 50% ticket cell has n=2. This does not show repetition is protective.
Eligible incident successes fall to 84 at step 11 while 705 failures remain. Higher late errors among successes are not beneficial effects; always report surviving n.
EDA SYNTHESIS · FROM FINDINGS TO CONSTRAINTS
separate alerts, false stops, success loss

Quality floor: no missing, negative or non-finite values in valid analysis fields; 62 time and 31 token outliers audited and retained.
Invalid rates at 50/10 workers: 8.00%/1.03%; date and provider state are confounded.
03 | FROM EDA TO THE FROZEN TEST: risk is predictable; loss-free stopping is not

22 observable features; at most 6 prefixes/task
LR C=1; KNN k=9; fixed/step/never-stop rules
19,094 training prefixes; 3-fold parent-family CV
5% validation false-stop budget; one frozen test
Of 267 failure alerts, 154 occur after first violation; 55 at the same step and 32 before.
Under the same 5% validation budget, KNN and rules select no-stop; the test has only two parent families.

Exploratory 48-feature extension (seen test set, not a new blind test): savings 5.39%→5.83%; false stops 4→3; detections by step 6: 14→60. Strict successes remain below baseline; the frozen conclusion stands.

EDA | Errors are not labels, late gaps are not early signals, and correlation is not causation.
Study | Runtime signals support risk monitoring and reduce some later waste; violation prevention, loss-free stopping and online gains remain unproven.
Presentation | Understand failure and recovery first; protect recoverable successes before claiming execution savings.
Real LLM + local simulated tools · EDA figures use training data only · Seedream 5.5 created header decoration only, never study figures or numbers

zh_a1.text: 探索性数据分析（EDA） · LLM AGENT RELIABILITY
AgentSentinel-Lite
工具报错 ≠ 任务失败｜从运行轨迹理解风险、恢复与停止代价
以 Proposal 的三个研究问题为主线 · 6,000 次真实模型运行 · 训练集 EDA · 冻结测试
采集运行
有效任务
可决策前缀
训练集 EDA
01｜研究设计：在第 t 步，只能根据已经发生的事判断最终失败
实际数据与严格切分

20 模板 × 20 实例 × 5 条件 × 3 重复 = 6,000
工单 + 服务事件；正常/超时/限流/Schema/部分响应
训练/验证/测试 = 3,542 / 1,176 / 1,176；父家族 6/2/2
同一模板及全部前缀不跨区；106 条无效运行只作质量审计
前缀预测，而非事后诊断
$p_{s,t}=P(Y_s=1 \mid X_{s,\leq t})$

工具返回后才评分；只使用当前及过去事件。
故障配置、未来步骤和验证器答案不作输入。
预测与停止分开评价

错误/重试/重复、Token/费用/时间、工具与写入阶段
LR + KNN + 固定规则；验证集限制成功任务误停预算
同时报告失败召回、告警时机、费用节省和成功损失
本批没有在线干预；所有停止收益均来自离线回放
02｜EDA：五张图回答 Proposal 的核心问题
仅训练分区：3,542 个有效任务 / 27,367 条前缀；验证与测试不参与 EDA。补充图表属于事后探索，未用于改写冻结主实验；描述性关联不作因果解释。
RQ2 · 故障与任务结构
故障影响取决于工作流
部分响应：服务事件 45.9%，工单仅 8.7%。正常条件仍有 170 次失败；模板失败率 0.67%–90.41%，所以必须分面并按父家族切分。
RQ1 + RQ2 · 错误恢复与完成时点
错误可恢复，成功也可能很晚
51.21% 的成功任务出现显式错误；读取错误恢复 4,031/5,926（68.02%）。77 个成功直到第 12 步才首次达标：报错不能直接当作停止理由。
RQ1 · 完整轨迹与早期资源对照
完整资源差异 ≠ 早期可分
STEP 3
完整 Token 中位数明显分离；但第 3 步均值：服务事件成功/失败 4,277/4,226，工单 4,246/4,289。事后总消耗不能伪装成早期信号。
RQ1 · 固定第 3 步的错误 × 重复
简单阈值并不稳定
先看 n
服务事件“0 错误”格中，有重复反而失败更少（15.8% vs 42.8%）；工单一个 50% 格子仅 n=2。不能据此声称重复有保护作用。
RQ1 · 跨步趋势与样本组成
后期曲线已不是同一批任务
服务事件成功任务的可决策样本到第 11 步仅剩 84，失败仍有 705。后期成功曲线错误更多，不表示错误有益；必须同时看 surviving n。
EDA SYNTHESIS · 从发现到实验约束
EDA 不是装饰，而是建模规则
固定第 3 步 Spearman：信息高度重叠
重试 ↔ 重复
Token ↔ 费用
Token ↔ Reasoning
任务异质性
父家族分组 CV + 逐家族报告
晚恢复 / 曾经达标
告警、误停与成功损失分开
早期弱分离 / 高相关
联合特征 + 固定步评价 + 消融

质量底线：有效分析字段无缺失、负值或非有限值；62 条时间与 31 条 Token 外点回查后保留。
50/10 并发的无效率 8.00%/1.03%，但与日期和供应方状态混杂。
03｜从 EDA 到冻结主实验：风险可预测，无损停止未实现
冻结模型与公平比较
预测质量 ≠ 违规预防
费用节省 ≠ 无损收益

22 项可观察特征；每任务最多 6 条前缀
LR C=1；KNN k=9；固定/步数/永不停规则
19,094 条训练前缀；3 折父家族 CV
验证集 5% 误停预算选阈值，测试只评一次
ROC AUC：全前缀 0.8413｜第 3 步 0.7422
首次违规前覆盖 32/268
267 次失败告警中，154 次晚于首次违规；55 次同步，32 次提前。
估算费用节省
同一 5% 验证预算下，KNN 与规则均选择不停止；测试仅 2 个父家族。
后续 48 特征探索（复用已见测试集，非新盲测）：费用节省 5.39%→5.83%，误停 4→3，第 6 步前识别 14→60；严格成功仍低于原基线，不能替代冻结主结论。

EDA 结论｜错误不是标签，晚期差异不是早期信号，相关不是因果。
研究结论｜运行信号适合风险监测并减少部分后续浪费；当前不能承诺违规前预防、无损自动停止或在线收益。
汇报主线｜先理解失败与恢复，再评价预测；先保护可恢复的成功任务，再讨论节省。
Proposal：AgentSentinel_Lite_Proposal.md｜结果：RESEARCH_REPORT_6000_FINAL.md（2026-11-06）
